items.heading: Fish Amok
details: Key ingredients: fish, coconut milk, kroeung paste, egg, banana leaf
Blend lemongrass, galangal and turmeric into a fragrant kroeung paste.
Mix the paste with coconut milk, egg and flaked fish.
Spoon the mixture into banana leaf cups.
Steam until just set into a soft, custardy curry.

items.heading: Khmer Beef Lok Lak
details: Key ingredients: beef, garlic, soy sauce, lime, lettuce, tomato
Marinate cubed beef in garlic, soy sauce and a touch of sugar.
Sear the beef quickly over high heat, keeping it tender.
Plate over a bed of lettuce and tomato.
Serve with a lime-pepper dipping sauce on the side.
